Travel and exploration

Check player shops on the map before travelling

Open the map and select a player shop icon to check goods and prices before making the trip. The marker disappears when the shop sells out. When running your own shop, place the vending machine within a cupboard's zone or others may take goods and earnings from the back. Empty the earnings storage regularly; trades stop when it is full.
